description: OpenGL Utility (GLU) -> Direct3D 9 for Xbox 360. Matrix builders map to D3DX; texture build maps to the D3D9 texture helper; picking maps to the D3D9 software-pick helper. No OpenGL at runtime.

direct3d9.note: builds the projection matrix and pushes it to the matrix stack
same texture-upload helper as glTexImage2D (LIN_A8R8G8B8 + RGBA->ARGB)
narrow pick frustum around the cursor; pairs with the D3D9 software-pick pass
